$comment: VALUES the loop reads, nothing else. This file holds only numbers, names, and ids, never rules or rationale. The rule lives in the skill that enforces it. The story lives in docs/why.md. Each run reads this file fresh from main, so a merge here changes only the next run.

ceilings.$comment: Stock caps and per-run backstops, never a flow quota. At 8 runs/day, a 'per run' allowance equals 8x a daily one. Rules in work-routine/SKILL.md.

labels.$comment: Two labels. journal excludes the diary from every worklist. awaiting is the main signal for human attention. The state-machine workflow writes it, and the loop writes it too, only for four dead ends. Rules in triage-issue/SKILL.md.

assignment.$comment: assignee:<bot> is the worklist. Only the user writes it. The loop may only remove itself. respondTo lists the logins whose comments count as feedback. Rules in triage-issue/SKILL.md.

mergePolicy.$comment: Repos where the loop may open and revise PRs, never merge them, whatever the gate says. claude-workflow ships the instructions every run executes, so merging there is the deploy, done only by a human. The repo is ticketless, so review is its only gate.

surveyCalendar.$comment: Weekday -> survey skill. Only survey-routine dispatches these. Saturday runs no survey. Keys are lowercase UTC weekday names, from `date -u +%A | tr A-Z a-z`.

analysisAngles: feature research against current best practice

sentry.$comment: DE region: the global sentry.io host 404s here. The token lacks org:read, so /organizations/ also 403s. SahajAtlasWordpress ships no Sentry.

mailpit.$comment: Basic-auth credentials live in the cloud environment as MAILPIT_UI_AUTH, never here.

issueFields.$comment: GitHub's native org-level issue fields, not Projects v2, not labels. You can read and write them, but not search them. See triage-issue/SKILL.md for read/write rules and the PUT-replaces-everything trap.

relationships.$comment: No MCP tool reads blocked_by. So a cloud run reads this marker from the issue body instead. Set the real relationship locally, then mirror it here.
relationships.recheckProbe: select:mcp__github__issue_dependency_read — if this ever resolves, switch work-routine to the tool and retire the body-marker fallback

identity.$comment: expectedLogin is authoritative. Each run checks it against get_me once. Attribution rules in work-routine/SKILL.md.
identity.commentMarker: <sub>🤖 Written by the sydevs autonomous loop — see [what this is](https://github.com/sydevs/claude-workflow#the-loop)</sub>

review.$comment: Rung 5 / adversarial-review. Advisory only. Rules in adversarial-review/SKILL.md.

journal.$comment: One issue per day in journalRepo, created lazily. The title reports run health. Volume lives on the board. No issue number appears here, since the run finds today's by creation date.

projects.$comment: The org workflow board is a lens over Stage, awaiting, and PR review state. The loop never reads or writes it. Story in docs/why.md#the-board-is-a-lens.
projects.recheckProbe: select:mcp__github__projects_list — probed ABSENT 2026-09-03 (session cse_0188Trog41g4Zt2j9oQS9crB); if this ever resolves from a routine, Projects v2 became reachable

stateMachine.$comment: The workflow that owns every mechanical Stage, assignee, and awaiting transition. Values only. The division of labor is in preflight/SKILL.md and docs/why.md#the-state-machine-is-not-the-loops-job.

writing.$comment: Character budgets for everything the loop writes, counted including <details>. Bodies are deliberately unbudgeted. They are state, and grounding reads them instead of the thread. workflow/lib/budget.mjs enforces this. Rules are in preflight/SKILL.md.
